/.title: PULSE — Precision User Latency & Stimulus Evaluator
/.description: A browser-based cognitive benchmarking suite measuring visual reaction latency, directional choice speed, and working memory with millisecond-resolution timing.

/about.title: About PULSE — Cognitive Benchmarking Suite
/about.description: Learn about PULSE (Precision User Latency & Stimulus Evaluator), our standardized browser-based cognitive tests, telemetry engine, and privacy standards.

/assessments.title: Cognitive Tests for Reaction Time & Memory | PULSE
/assessments.description: Browser-based tests measuring reaction time, directional choice speed, color recognition, block recall, and number memory.

/leaderboard.title: Verified Leaderboard & Cohort Rankings | PULSE
/leaderboard.description: Compare anonymous PULSE assessment results across reaction time, attention, and memory with verified cohort rankings.

/dataset.title: Dataset Coming Soon | PULSE
/dataset.description: The public PULSE research dataset is being prepared for release.

/improve.title: Improve Reaction Time & Memory | PULSE
/improve.description: Review research, physiological factors, and preparation habits that affect response time and measurement consistency.

/privacy.title: Research Data Ethics & Privacy Policy | PULSE
/privacy.description: Our commitment to transparent research standards, strict data anonymization, telemetry consent guidelines, and open scientific integrity.

/reaction-test.title: Reaction Time Test | Visual Reaction Test | PULSE
/reaction-test.description: Benchmark visual reaction time using PULSE's browser-based reaction test, featuring randomized stimulus delays and an estimated display refresh adjustment.

/direction-test.title: Directional Choice Test: Response Speed | PULSE
/direction-test.description: Measure choice reaction time and directional accuracy with PULSE's arrow-based task, designed to test how quickly you recognize and respond to visual direction cues.

/colour-recognition.title: Colour Recognition Test: Stroop Task | PULSE
/colour-recognition.description: Test selective attention and Stroop interference by identifying colour stimuli in PULSE's browser-based colour recognition assessment.

/block-memory.title: Block Memory Test: Spatial Sequence Recall | PULSE
/block-memory.description: Test visuospatial working memory with PULSE's block sequence recall task: observe the pattern, then repeat the blocks in the correct order.

/number-memory.title: Number Memory Test: Forward Digit Recall | PULSE
/number-memory.description: Measure short-term memory with PULSE's forward digit-span test, which asks you to recall increasingly long number sequences in their original order.
